title: Beautiful Christmas Cookie Jar - Would highly recommend!
text: Beautiful Christmas Cookie Jar - Would highly recommend!. I ordered this for my MIL for an early Christmas present since hers broke in storage over the season. She LOVED it, as did I. Very cute details of a deer, bird, etc. Great size. Not too big, but not too small either. LOVE the retro looking Santa. Would highly recommend! Super FAST shipping too, came 2 days earlier than expected. A+++

product_metadata.title: Certified International Magic of Christmas Santa Cookie Jar, Multicolored
features: Includes: Magic Of Christmas Santa Cookie Jar
Hand Painted and Made with Durable Earthenware
description: Bring Santa and his adorable furry critters into your home with Certified International’s “Magic of Christmas-Santa” ceramic dinnerware and serveware designed by Susan Winget. There are 4 assorted chubby Santas surrounded by woodland friends with sentiments of the season and plaid accents against a snowy landscape. Complete your collection with the 3-d Santa cookie jar and S&P set. These Santa decors coordinate beautifully with the matching Snowman collection for a colorful holiday look.
